title.rendered: CSM tube bending machine at ACME – Chennai

content.rendered:
CSM tube bending machine at ACME – Chennai

CutTech’s CSM Tube Bender Steals the Show at ACME Chennai

We are very excited to announce that CutTech recently exhibited our CSM Tube Bender at ACME Chennai, one of the largest manufacturing conferences featuring innovations, and a great place for manufacturing professionals to gather. Our CSM Tube Bender stole the show, and here is why it is quickly becoming the most sought-after technology in tube bending.

What Makes the CSM Tube Bending Machine So Different?

Precision Bending Every Time: Our servo-controlled technology is cutting-edge and ensures precision and consistency is achieved, regardless of bend complexity.

Allows All Metals: The CSM Bender accepts stainless steel, aluminum, mild steel, and even some other metal tubes with no problems.

User Friendly Controls: The user-friendly controls will limit the amount of time your technicians spend programming and training on technique, which creates better productivity for you.

Space saving and Compact Design:  The small design fits into any workshop or shop environment and is great for saving floor space.

Quick and Efficient: The CSM’s speed keeps jobs being completed at a faster pace, with no loss of quality.

Low Maintenance: Built to last, the machine will spend less time in maintenance and costs for repairs.

Highlights from ACME Chennai

At ACME, we showed everyone how effortlessly the CSM tackles even the most difficult bends, and we impressed people with how smoothly the machine runs while also being able to handle bends with tight radiuses. We heard from industry experts who said, “Wow, what a perfect balance of speed and accuracy.” In addition, we spoke to many manufacturers who seemed very eager to identify efficient and reliable tube bending solutions, which is exactly what the CSM provides.

Why CutTech’s CSM Tube Bending Machine?

The CSM is the perfect tube bending machine for industries like automotive, furniture, construction, and general manufacturing, and it helps to improve production efficiencies; reduce wastage of materials, and produces manufacturing solutions for companies of all sizes without even sacrificing their quality offensive.

If you couldn’t make it to ACME Chennai, don’t worry! Contact CutTech today to arrange a demonstration for your specific application and see for yourself how the CSM Tube Bending Machine can help improve your manufacturing operations.”
